exposure: previous open repair of a hernia
cohort: 222 patients with reducible or irreducible, uncomplicated recurrent ventral hernia who underwent surgical management from January 2012 to June 2018
finding: Obesity, old age, female sex, previous lower abdominal surgeries, and previous open repair of a hernia are factors associated with recurrence.
mod_finding: This study found that previous lower abdominal surgeries, including cesarean sections, were associated with an increased risk of recurrent ventral hernia.
